name: Daewoo Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Daewoo Engineering & Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the engineering and construction business in South Korea and internationally. The company operates through the Civil works, Housing and architectural construction, Plants, and Others segments. It builds civil infrastructure projects, including highways, roads, bridges, railways, subways, harbors and reclamation facilities, environmental, and leisure projects. The company also constructs housing projects, such as apartments, studio apartments, urban lifestyle homes, urban residential, commercial complexes, town houses, and villas; and non-residential facilities, such as commercial facilities, offices, data centers, and others.
